title: The smooth purity isomorphism Rf^! Q̄_ℓ ≅ Q̄_ℓ(d)[2d] with condensed coefficients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $k$ a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and let $\underline\Omega$ be the condensed ring whose sections on a profinite set are continuous functions with values in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$ [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit]. Put $B_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$ for $T=X,Y$, use the bounded constructible condensed-module categories $\mathcal C_T$ of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and write $\iota_T:\mathcal C_T\hookrightarrow D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_T})$ for their full inclusions. Write $F=Rf_!:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Y$ for compact-support direct image [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek], $G=Rf^!$ for its chosen right adjoint, and $\varepsilon:FG\to\mathrm{id}$ for the counit [sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek]. Put $A=\iota_X(G\mathbf1_Y)$ and $T_d=B_X(d)[2d]$, where the actual condensed Tate construction is [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists].

The data specifying the smooth purity isomorphism are the following existing constructions. For $n\geq1$ put $A_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, $L_n=A_{n,Y}$, and $M_n=A_{n,X}(d)[2d]$, with quotient and root-power transitions. Use the specified diagonal/deformation-to-the-normal-cone finite purity maps $\phi_n=\gamma_{n,L_n}:M_n\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_n^!L_n$ and their exceptional coefficient comparisons [lem-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-general-base]. Let $L=R\varprojlim L_n$ and $M=R\varprojlim M_n$ be the actual derived limits, with the normalized reductions, completed integral constructibility and common cohomological bounds of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower]. Let $U_T$ denote completed coefficient realization followed by rationalization and extension to $\underline\Omega$, as defined in [lem-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction]. Let $u:U_YL\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_Y$ be the canonical identification of the realized integral unit with the tensor unit given by the case $d=0$, on the scheme $Y$, of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization] (its hypothesis that $L$ lies in the completed integral constructible category with canonical reductions $L_n$ is supplied by [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower]), read in $\mathcal C_Y$ through the full faithfulness of $\iota_Y$. Let $c_{f,L,M_\bullet}:U_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}G(U_YL)$ be the specified adjunction comparison of [lem-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction] for these towers; its single-degree case (b) applies with $r=-2d$. Put
$$c=G(u)\circ c_{f,L,M_\bullet}:U_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}G\mathbf1_Y.$$
Use the canonical Tate realization
$$a:\iota_X(U_XM)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_d$$
of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization].

Define the smooth purity isomorphism by the actual composite
$$\gamma_f:A\xrightarrow{(\iota_Xc)^{-1}}\iota_X(U_XM)\xrightarrow{a}T_d.$$
Here $\iota_Xc$ denotes the image isomorphism. To specify the trace without choosing arbitrary isomorphism data, represent $T_d$ in $\mathcal C_X$ by $U_XM$ with the specified ambient identification $a$. Define
$$t_f=\varepsilon_{\mathbf1_Y}\circ F(c):F(U_XM)\longrightarrow\mathbf1_Y.$$
Read through $a$, this is the normalized smooth trace $Rf_!(B_X(d)[2d])\to B_Y$. Equivalently, its adjoint, read in the ambient category through $a$, is
$$\alpha_f:T_d\xrightarrow{a^{-1}}\iota_X(U_XM)\xrightarrow{\iota_Xc}A,$$
and the definition above is $\gamma_f=\alpha_f^{-1}$. The trace normalization is that of the finite diagonal/deformation maps and their counits in [lem-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-general-base, lem-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction]. The common-stage category of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] is related to this condensed realization by comparison, not used as the definition of the condensed ring.

split_report.summary: Split this definition into its existing construction dependencies: the normalized finite smooth maps, actual integral Tate tower, specified condensed exceptional reconstruction, and canonical condensed Tate realization. Define gamma as c inverse followed by a and its trace as the counit composed with F(c); adjunction makes the original inverse-of-trace-adjoint characterization literal. Correct the common-stage-category citation used as a condensed-ring definition. No new nodes, no Lean edits, no arbitrary choice of a purity witness.
split_report.blueprint: Latest blueprint sk-thm-purity-transport proof Steps 1–4: normalized finite reductions, integral/rational/condensed realization, and counit-preserving adjunction comparison; sk-def-sp-trace defines the trace as counit after purity. Historical ancestor thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity has the same transport intent, but its fixed finite-field conventions are not substituted for the arbitrary field in this item.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NM-0ba466602 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the whole definition, all 11 stmt_deps and the archived master smoothPurityIso (Defs.lean in upstream-master-20261016). The hypotheses, ring, objects and direction match the master declaration: ring padicAlgClRingObj = prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit, source boundedConstructibleUpperShriek applied to the unit, target tateTwistDerived d shifted by 2d, smooth of pure relative dimension d, char p>0 with p≠ℓ. The base citation of the common-stage def-weil-pbc-qbar-category as the ring was a real E4 error, and the worker corrected it. The construction checks out link by link. The finite maps of lem-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-general-base use the diagonal/DNC route (no SGA, so the route lock holds) and work for any field. lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower supplies every hypothesis of lem-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction (normalized tower, intertwining φ_n, case (b) with r=-2d, common bounds, M in I_X). The reconstruction node pins c through the finite counits, so it is data, not an arbitrary choice. lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization's M_d and U_X are literally the item's. The formal step holds: the transpose of ε∘F(c) is c, so γ_f = a∘(ιc)^{-1} = α_f^{-1}, which agrees with sk-def-sp-trace. No cycle; all deps split and in the same unit; no new nodes. Duplicate search: the candidates lem-pur-condensed-normalized-witness (an existence statement only), def-pur-smooth-trace/-purity-map (finite coefficients over F̄_q) and the common-stage realizations are not this definition, so dropping same_as thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity is correct. Edge cases checked: d=0, f=id, d=1 (degree -2), X empty. FIX (C4/E5): the item cited the reconstruction node for 'U_Y L is canonically 1_Y' and used c: U_X M → G 1_Y 'with the identification understood'. But that node maps only the integral coefficient object to the unit, and its c lands in G(U_Y L) with L = R lim L_n. The corrected statement takes u: U_Y L ≅ 1_Y from the d=0 clause of lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization on Y (L in I_Y comes from the tower node) and defines c = G(u)∘c_{f,L,M•}. stmt_deps and all other fields are unchanged. Advisory: def-weil-pbc-qbar-category remains as a stmt_dep only for a disclaimer sentence. A parallel Q106 delivery for this item exists.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
